description: Defines Swagger API models (request and response schemas) for the TaxComponent API in the Fineract project, including classes for responses, requests, and their nested components.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes defining Swagger schemas for tax component API responses and requests.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.GetTaxesComponentsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response returned when fetching tax components.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.GetTaxesComponentsCreditAccountType
classes.description: Schema for credit account type details within the tax component response.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.GetTaxesComponentsCreditAccount
classes.description: Schema for credit account details within the tax component response.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.GetTaxesComponentsHistories
classes.description: Schema for tax component history details.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.PostTaxesComponentsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new tax component request.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.PostTaxesComponentsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a tax component.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.PutTaxesComponentsTaxComponentIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a tax component.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResourceSwagger.PutTaxesComponentsTaxComponentIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a tax component, including nested changes details.
